title: Fourier norm of a sign restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a subset of its coordinates, and fix signs $z$ outside $J$. The sum of the absolute values of all Fourier coefficients of the restriction of $f$ to the free coordinates in $J$, with the outside coordinates fixed to $z$, is at most the Fourier one-norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinate set
